description: Places text, a picture or a clip on the video for chosen seconds, in a box (x, y its centre; width, height; fractions of the frame), with an optional animation. overlay_id replaces that overlay. Saves a new version, all or nothing; restore_version undoes it. Cost: Free: no credits.

align.description: kind text: alignment in the box.

animation.description: How it arrives and leaves; none (a cut) when left out.

asset_id.description: kind image or video: an asset_id from import_media or list_assets.

base_version.description: The version_id you read; refused if the video changed since. Left out: the live version, and a repeat is saved once.

font.description: kind text: the face; Inter-Medium when left out.

font_size.description: kind text: letter height, a fraction of the frame height; 0.05 when left out.

height.description: Box height, a fraction of the frame.

operation_id.description: The same id on a retry runs it once; a new id is a new request.

output_id.description: A Short, hook or shape of the video; the main video when left out.

overlay_id.description: An overlay to replace (ov_ id from get_timeline); a new overlay when left out.

source_in.description: kind video: the second of the clip it starts from.

until_end.description: true: it stays to the end of the video whatever its length.

width.description: Box width, a fraction of the frame.

x.description: Centre across, 0 to 1 of the width.

y.description: Centre down, 0 to 1 of the height.

name: put_overlay

outputSchema.description: Clypmint put_overlay result. Error results carry error; successful requests expose the identifiers and state available for the next step. Signed media stays in private metadata.

title: Add or replace an overlay
